preconditions.description: The number of elements in the sequence n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 10**9 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each element ai in the sequence a2, a3, ..., an is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n - 1 lines.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == -1 or (isinstance(output[i], int) and output[i] >= 0) for i in range(n - 1))
postconditions.description: Each output value is either -1 or a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == simulate(i + 1, a) for i in range(n - 1))
postconditions.description: Each output value is the final value of y for the sequence starting with i + 1, followed by a2, a3, ..., an, or -1 if the program does not terminate.
